projectDescription: An ASP.NET Core MVC web application for logistics route management, built for ScanMex, featuring route planning with Google Maps integration, package cubicage, SAP client data, and role-based access control.
keyFeatures: Interactive route planning with Google Maps DirectionsService and real traffic data
Daily route cards grouped by day of week with simulated delivery destinations
Drag-and-drop destination grid for building routes with checkbox selection
New route request form with real address geocoding and route distance/time calculation
Package cubicage (volume) calculator for envelope, box, and pallet shipments
AI route suggestion stub (POST /api/rutas-mapa/sugerir) ready for LLM integration
Role-based access control (Administrator, Supervisor, Operator) with module-level permissions
SAP Business One client data auto-fill from multiple company databases (CDMX, MTY, GDL, Bajío)
In-memory route repository (IRutaRepository) with SQL Server migration path via dependency injection
Base64-encoded credential obfuscation with User Secrets support for local development
Folio generation for route requests (REC-XXXXXX / ENT-XXXXXX format)
publicApiSurface: GET  /api/rutas-mapa/{rutaId} — get a route by ID
POST /api/solicitudes-ruta/simular — simulate a new route request and generate folio
GET  /Rutas/ObtenerRutas — list all routes from DB (with operator filter for Operador role)
POST /Rutas/GuardarRuta — persist a full route with destinations to SQL Server
POST /Rutas/FinalizarRuta — mark a route as finished
GET  /Usuarios/GetModulosUsuario?usuario= — get assigned modules for a user
POST /Usuarios/CreateUser — create a new platform user
